निस् ind. As a prefix to verbal themes it implies- (1) separation, outside of, away from, (e.g. निर्गम्); (2) certainty, (e.g. निरुक्त); (3) thoroughness, (e.g. निर्जित); (4) enjoyment, (e.g. निर्विश्) &c.It is prefixed to nouns not immediately derived from verbs to form nouns or adjectives in the sense of- (1) out of, away from, (e.g. निष्कौषांबि); 2. not, without, (e.g. निर्मल).
